title: Liz Rockett (Mission Lock Collective, ex-KP Ventures) — 'this applies extra to us' in healthcare
summary: Liz Rockett — healthcare impact investor with Mission Lock Collective, formerly at Imprint Capital, KP Ventures, and Unseen Capital — publishes a substantive halfway-through review connecting Incorruptible directly to the mission-lock frameworks she's been developing for healthcare capital. She's convening a book club with healthcare peers.
blockquote:
He talks about purpose in a way that isn't all fluff, but as a key way to protect against the extractive instincts of investor owners.

And he describes the effect that all this has on those of us trying to build something better — "under this constant friction, good people lose their will to fight" — how many amazing leaders have we seen churn out of this work?
attribution_title: Mission Lock Collective; formerly Imprint Capital, KP Ventures, Unseen Capital
